findings.text: [A]: the hills and sky are smooth airbrushed gradients with a soft glow around the moon, so up close it reads as polished digital render rather than something painted by hand; it leans slick.
[B]: the black outline wobbles and swells along the hill, like an inked line drawn with a brush, and the cream area has a faint paper-like warmth, so it feels drawn rather than extruded.
[B]: the deep teal is the only green-ish note among the four, a garden-at-dusk color that warms me, though the huge cropped 6 crowds the scene.
[C]: flat navy and cream with a perfectly even, compass-drawn outline; clean and legible, but geometric and cool, closer to a badge than a hand-colored page.
[D]: the lumpy, uneven purple blobs look like moss or clouds dabbed on with a sponge, the most hand-grown texture here, and the thin serif 4 sits on them like a handwritten label in an herbal.
None of the four has visible paper grain or brush texture at 100%; every fill is vector-flat or gradient, so all of them could use a touch of handmade surface.
